# An explicit finite local GPT instrument and transactional compiler instance
2026-10-30. Constructive instantiation of the accepted finite-circuit transactional architecture, rather than an assumption that a GPT local decoder has already been compiled. The density theorem is now separately PASS under its actual GPT hypotheses; the integrated Tanner transfer is under independent review.

## 1. Fix the data to be reserved
Let w=Delta^2. Build one hub for each (CSS sector, vertex h in V0 union V1). Its correction masks are all subsets of Q(h), |Q(h)|=w. In this sector let

    V_h={v: Q(v) meets Q(h)},
    R_h=union_{v in V_h} Q(v).

Only potential terms in V_h can change under any candidate. Each data qubit is incident to two potential views, so |V_h|<=2w and |R_h|<=2w^2. Reserve EVERY data resource in R_h, not only Q(h). All data gates below are confined to R_h. The local workspace and clock are private hub resources. A resource's repaired tag alphabet contains free and BOTH labels o_h,z_h for every hub with q in R_h; bounded fixed degree gives an N-independent finite alphabet.

For every v in V_h select once and for all a basis of the local sector check space whose kernel is C_local. Embed these commuting stabilizer checks on Q(v). Keep duplicate checks if convenient. The concatenated measured list H_h has m_h<=2w^2 rows, each of weight <=w. Redundancies create only zero-probability incompatible outcomes. This is a LOCAL finite matrix, not a global syndrome inversion.

The complete physical footprint for transactional exclusion is R_h plus that hub's private workspace and clock and the resource-tag registers consulted by its gates. Conflict adjacency is enlarged accordingly. All relevant degrees remain constants at fixed Delta; the graph need not admit fixed-dimensional Euclidean embedding.

## 2. Explicit syndrome-only rule table
For each local check outcome z_v precompute

    t_v(z_v)=min{|r|: r in F_2^{Q(v)}, H_v r=z_v}.

For nonexistent local outcomes set an arbitrary default. Enumeration has at most 2^w masks per view. This minimization is over a FIXED local view only. It is not a hidden minimum-weight global decoder.

For each globally consistent local record y=(z_v)_{v in V_h}, and every f subset Q(h), compute

2026-10-30. New deterministic transfer, conditional on the independently reviewable general active-hub theorem. This is not a claim that the general-density construction has passed review.

## Contract and geometry
Work in one CSS sector. Let U(E)=sum_v dist(E|Q(v), C_local) be the GPT potential. Write w=Delta^2 and h=Delta^-2. The actual decoder at an evaluated hub searches all subsets of its w-qubit view and executes a strictly U-decreasing one whenever one exists. Exponential-in-w search is a blocklength-independent constant, not a practical efficiency claim. Both sectors require the corresponding primal and dual robustness assumptions.

Use a fixed bounded-degree DATA graph G which contains as cliques: every full local decision read footprint, every energy view Q(v), every stabilizer check support, and every declared elementary fault support. A decision read footprint includes enough raw stabilizer syndrome to compute all local distances affected by EVERY candidate at that hub. No decoder memory or auxiliary mismatch state is used. Let d be the maximum number of raw check bits toggled by a one-qubit error in this sector.

The needed deterministic inputs are:
1. U is exactly a function of the measured sector syndrome, hence is unchanged by stabilizers and by any same-syndrome replacement.

# Quantum Tanner local energy -> weighted animals -> linear-size coherent barrier

2026-10-30. Constructive interface proof. **The new active-hub density lemma is a separate load-bearing input under current derivation/audit; it is not implied by the published existence-of-a-flip theorem.** Subject to that lemma and the reviewed weighted-animal/killed-basin theorem, this lift gives exp(cN), rather than exp(c sqrt(N)), ideal-atomic decoded memory.

## 1. Exact primary-source imports

Use the Gu–Pattison–Tang decoder, not raw syndrome-Hamming descent. Its local energy is U_v(e)=dist(e restricted to Q(v),C_1^perp); U=sum U_v is syndrome-computable. The local view has Δ^2 qubits and each qubit belongs to two energy views. The decoder accepts any view-supported flip strictly decreasing U. Their Theorem 12 supplies constant-rate linear-distance families and a linear decoding radius; Corollary 14 supplies U(e)>=Δ^(-2)dist(e,stabilizers) in that radius. Their Theorem 10 proves existence of a decreasing move, not a linear number of active hubs.

Primary text: https://arxiv.org/html/2206.06557, Definition 9, Algorithm 1, Theorems 10–13, Corollary 14. The independently fixed local codes and expansion hypotheses must satisfy the theorem in BOTH CSS sectors. Choose fixed constants 0<ε_0<ε_1<1/28, a sufficiently large fixed Δ, and the stronger admissible local-code distance condition δ<h^(-1)(ρ), with 0<ρ<1/2.

Conservative source constants are

    r_code >= (1-2ρ)^2,
    d_rel >= δ/[4Δ^(3/2-ε_0)],
    r_dec = δ/[6Δ^(3/2-ε_0)(1+2Δ^2)].

Only positivity and N-independence of these constants are essential below. The Δ-dependent constants can be impractically large.

## 2. The density input is explicit, not hidden

For one CSS sector, let A(e) be the set of local-view hubs at which SOME allowed bounded-support flip lowers U. The required strengthening is

    |A(e)| >= κ_T U(e)                               (AD)

for every stabilizer-reduced nonzero e with |e|<=r_AD N, for N-independent κ_T,r_AD>0. One actual accepted flip is selected at each active hub. The selection need not be a special globally coordinated set.

The current robust-density construction is being checked independently by the SSF proof auditor. Until that construction is written and verified, all conclusions below are conditional on (AD). The published linear-time sequential decoder alone does NOT prove (AD)
